summary: App Engine supports granting application access through Google Groups added to a project.
extended_definition: App Engine supports granting application access through Google Groups added to a project.

supporting_pages.title: "Setting up access control \_|\_ App Engine standard environment \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Granting users access to Cloud resources If you want your app to read user data from another Google service, you'll need to set up OAuth 2.0 for Web Server Applications .

Granting access to team members To give a developer access to your Google Cloud project, create one or both of the following: A user account , which is associated with a Google account and is intended to represent a specific individual on your project.

Google Workspace domain-wide delegation of authority If you have a Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) domain, an administrator of the domain can authorize an application to access user data on behalf of users in the Google Workspace domain.
